title: Ediacaran–Cambrian boundary succession of the Nama Group, Namibia
note: Linnemann et al. 2019 (Terra Nova, doi 10.1111/ter.12368) date the boundary at 538.6–538.8 Ma and the Ediacaran-to-Cambrian faunal turnover to under 410 kyr in southern Namibia; an under-recorded African deep-time anchor.

title: Sinsk extinction event
note: Early Cambrian Stage 4 extinction (~513 Ma) on the Siberian Platform that removed many stem groups and archaeocyath reefs (Zhuravlev & Wood 2018, PMC6226464). Region code follows UN M49 (Russian Federation = Europe) although the site is in Siberia; coordinator may prefer northern Asia handling.

title: Kheseen Biota, Mongolia
note: Exceptionally preserved assemblage deposited ~550–526 Ma, discussed as a test of molecular-clock calibrations (Science Advances 2026, doi 10.1126/sciadv.aeg6289, PMC13632735). Under-recorded Central/East Asian deep-time locality.

title: Emu Bay Shale Lagerstätte, Kangaroo Island, South Australia
note: Early Cambrian soft-tissue deposit cited alongside Burgess Shale, Chengjiang and Sirius Passet (Kihm et al. 2023, PMC10334802); fills the Oceania × Paleozoic cell. Age needs checking against primary literature.

title: Chengjiang Fossil Site
note: Stub created by the Cambrian explosion record; UNESCO property 1388 (512 ha, inscribed 2012), maximum age 518.03 ± 0.71 Ma (Yang et al. 2018). Place record at importance ≥ 3 needs a model; discovery history (1984) still to source.

title: Bright Angel Formation biota, Grand Canyon
note: Middle Cambrian (~507–502 Ma) carbonaceous mesofossils showing evolutionary escalation in shallow water (Mussini et al. 2025, Science Advances, PMC12285723).
